Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Marketing position at [Company Name]. We appreciate the effort you put into your application and the opportunity to learn more about your background.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with the specific needs of this role at this time. Please know that this decision is not a reflection of your skills or potential, but rather a result of the competitive nature of our hiring process.

We were impressed by your qualifications and encourage you to keep an eye on our careers page for future opportunities that may be a better match. We wish you the very best in your job search and professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
